sloka: तस्मादेवमहं ब्रह्मन् वैवस्वतवधोद्यतः ।गच्छामि दक्षिणामाशां यत्र सूर्यात्मजो नृपः ।। ७.२०.२३ ॥
transliteration: tasmādevamahaṁ brahman vaivasvatavadhodyataḥ ।gacchāmi dakṣiṇāmāśāṁ yatra sūryātmajo nṛpaḥ ।। 7.20.23 ॥

translations.english: Dashanana, however, let out a laugh resembling an autumn cloud and then spoke these words, saying, "It is done."
